SAMPLE RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
(Fictional example for demonstration only. Not a real landlord, property or tenant.)

This Lease Agreement is made on November 2, 2026 between Placeholder Property Group LLC ("Landlord") and Sample Student ("Tenant") for the premises at 123 Example Street, Apt. 4, Ann Arbor, Michigan 48104 (the "Premises").

1. TERM
The lease term begins on September 1, 2027 and ends at 12:00 noon on August 31, 2028.

2. RENT
Tenant shall pay monthly rent of $1,350.00, due on the first day of each month. Rent paid after the fifth day of the month is subject to a late fee of $25.00.

3. PAYMENT OF RENT
Rent may be paid by check at the Landlord's office at no charge, or online through the resident portal for a processing fee of $2.95 per payment.

4. APPLICATION AND HOLDING FEES
Each applicant shall pay a non-refundable application fee of $75.00 per applicant. To reserve the Premises before the lease term begins, Tenant shall pay a holding fee of $300.00, which is not applied to rent or to the security deposit.

5. SECURITY DEPOSIT
Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $2,700.00 upon signing this Lease. Landlord will return the security deposit, less any lawful deductions, within 60 days after Tenant moves out.

6. AMENITY FEE
In addition to rent, Tenant shall pay a mandatory amenity fee of $40.00 per month for use of the fitness room and study lounge.

7. UTILITIES
Tenant is responsible for electricity and internet service. Landlord provides water, sewer and trash collection.

8. USE AND OCCUPANCY
The Premises shall be used only as a private residence for the Tenant named above. Quiet hours are from 11:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m. on weeknights.

9. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS
Tenant shall keep the Premises clean and shall promptly report any needed repairs to Landlord in writing. Landlord will make necessary repairs within a reasonable time after notice.

10. LIABILITY
Landlord shall not be liable for any injury, loss or damage to Tenant, Tenant's guests or Tenant's property, including any injury, loss or damage caused by the negligence of Landlord or Landlord's employees.

11. ENTRY AND SHOWINGS
Landlord may enter the Premises at reasonable times with 24 hours' notice to make repairs. Beginning 90 days after the start of the lease term, Landlord may show the Premises to prospective tenants with 24 hours' notice.

12. RENEWAL
If Landlord offers to renew this Lease, Tenant must accept the renewal offer in writing within 7 days after it is sent, or the offer will expire.

13. RULES AND REGULATIONS
Landlord may change or add to the rules and regulations of the building at any time, and the changes will become part of this Lease when posted in the lobby.

14. DEFAULT AND LEGAL COSTS
If Tenant breaks any term of this Lease, Tenant shall pay all of Landlord's attorney fees and collection costs, whether or not a lawsuit is filed.

15. JURY TRIAL
Tenant waives the right to a trial by jury in any lawsuit arising out of this Lease.

16. PETS
No pets are allowed without Landlord's written consent. Approved pets require a pet fee of $25.00 per month.

17. SMOKING
Smoking is not permitted anywhere in the building.

18. NOTICES
Notices to Landlord shall be sent to Placeholder Property Group LLC, 456 Sample Avenue, Ann Arbor, Michigan 48103.

19. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Lease is the entire agreement between Landlord and Tenant.

Landlord: ______________________    Tenant: ______________________
